# The Republic

> Independent creative and advertising agency in Lagos, Nigeria (The Republic Studios Ltd, RC 7371417). Strategy-led campaigns, content, digital work and brand experiences for African and global brands, including Promasidor, CHI, Prudential Zenith Life Insurance, Zenith Bank, Sanlam Allianz and CAP Plc (Spruce by Dulux).

Address: 10 Onisiwo Road, Ikoyi, Lagos, Nigeria. Email: office@therepublic.agency.
Leadership: Ola Olowu (Chairman & Co-Founder), Daniel Emeka (Managing Director & Co-Founder), Aderoju Adeniji (Head of Operations & Client Service).
How we work: strategy first. Every brief starts with questions about people and moves through five steps: the problem, the human truth, the idea, the system and the evidence.

## Services

- [Communication Strategy](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/communication-strategy): Brand and communication strategy from The Republic in Lagos: the human truth, the brand role and the plan behind campaigns for Promasidor and Zenith Bank.
- [Brand & Creative](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/brand-and-creative): Advertising ideas, TV commercials, launch films and brand identity from The Republic, a creative agency in Lagos for banks, insurers and consumer brands.
- [Content & Social](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/content-and-social): Social media management, creator partnerships and content series from The Republic in Lagos, for brands that want conversation as well as reach.
- [Integrated Marketing](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/integrated-marketing): Integrated advertising campaigns from The Republic, Lagos: one idea carried through film, outdoor, radio, digital, social and experiences to one next step.
- [Digital & Performance](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/digital-and-performance): Digital strategy, amplification, paid media and lead capture from The Republic, a digital marketing agency in Lagos, for results brands can measure.
- [Experiences](https://www.therepublic.agency/services/experiences): Brand experiences, installations and activations from The Republic in Lagos, such as the Zenith Bank 35th anniversary Tunnel of Time and the Twisco activation.

## Selected work

- [Taste of Home](https://www.therepublic.agency/onga-taste-of-home): Onga · Promasidor Nigeria. A digital platform built from people’s answers to one question: what does home mean to you?
- [Your First Taste](https://www.therepublic.agency/cowbell-ramadan-your-first-taste): Cowbell · Promasidor Nigeria. Nigerian digital and social execution of a Ramadan campaign about who cares before the first taste.
- [Show Your True Colours](https://www.therepublic.agency/spruce-dulux-digital-launch): Spruce by Dulux · CAP Plc. Creators, social distribution and digital visualisation for a paint launch.
- [Empowering Tomorrow](https://www.therepublic.agency/prudential-zenith-empowering-tomorrow): Prudential Zenith Life. An integrated campaign that made the next 40 years personal and planning practical.
- [See Homecoming Differently](https://www.therepublic.agency/zenith-bank-homecoming): Zenith Bank. A strategy and creative platform for Nigerians coming home every December.
- [Everyday Hero, Everyday Twisco](https://www.therepublic.agency/twisco-everyday-hero): Twisco. Give a cocoa drink a real role in family life.
- [12 Days of Christmas](https://www.therepublic.agency/chivita-12-days-of-christmas): CHI Limited. A festive season of live shows, challenges and hampers.
- [What’s Your Chivita?](https://www.therepublic.agency/chivita-2-campaign): CHI Limited. Turn consumers into storytellers.
- [Ramadan TVCs](https://www.therepublic.agency/chivita-hollandia-ramadan): CHI Limited. Two commercials for a season of togetherness.
- [Style N’ Sips](https://www.therepublic.agency/chivita-style-n-sips): CHI Limited. A YouTube series of style, humour and real talk.
- [You Matter](https://www.therepublic.agency/prudential-zenith-you-matter): Prudential Zenith Life Insurance. A strategy campaign to make insurance feel human again.
- [Live with Confidence](https://www.therepublic.agency/sanlam-allianz-live-with-confidence): Sanlam Allianz. Insurance, reframed around what people want.
- [We Do Dreams](https://www.therepublic.agency/prudential-zenith-we-do-dreams): Prudential Zenith Life Insurance. Break through where insurance is misunderstood.
- [Content & Social](https://www.therepublic.agency/prudential-zenith-social-content): Prudential Zenith Life Insurance. Humour, relevance and relatability for an insurer.
- [Launch Video](https://www.therepublic.agency/heirs-insurance-launch): Heirs Insurance. A new insurer’s first impression.
- [Secure the Bag](https://www.therepublic.agency/i-invest-secure-the-bag): i-invest. A TVC for young professionals building wealth.
- [The Future of Zenith](https://www.therepublic.agency/zenith-bank-35th-anniversary): Zenith Bank. Thirty-five years, walked through.
- [See for Yourself](https://www.therepublic.agency/torrista-see-for-yourself): Sterling Bank. Travel, made accessible, affordable and authentic.

## Recognition

- Nigerian Marketing Awards 2024: Best Use of Social Media, winner, for the Chivita 2.0 campaign (https://www.nma-ng.com/2024-winners/).
- Nigerian Marketing Awards 2025: Financial Institution of the Year, second place, The Republic, for You Matter with Prudential Zenith Life (https://www.nma-ng.com/winners/).
